title: Setup → Users list has no Status (banned) or Role column, so a banned user or an admin cannot be spotted from the list (#27521 row 15)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC

Filing gate: ② a wrong or confusing state shown to the user. Split from #27521 row 15 by the seat; the parent's acceptance says each row is taken as its own card or answered.

## Business reason

Who: every administrator on Users. What happens: the list shows name, email, phone, email verified, identity source and created — nothing says whether a user is banned or what role they hold, so finding banned users or admins means opening each record. Reach: every administrator on Users.

## Mechanism

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts` list views: `all_users` columns are name, email, phone, email verified, identity source, created.

Measured at `main` @ `561b7642`, re-driven (stock `examples/app-showcase --seed-admin`, admin, Chromium 1440×900).

## Wanted

Status (banned) and Role columns on the Users list.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The default Users list shows a Status column that marks banned users and a Role column with labels.
- [ ] A test pins the `all_users` columns.

Refs #27521
